value.rationale: Successive complete-coverage episodes form a regenerative count process whose long-time Fano factor is the squared cycle CV. The critical loss scaling has an unexpectedly nonmonotone dispersion curve with a unique sub-/super-Poisson crossover and two global extrema; the mean flux alone cannot detect this behavior. This is a complete, naturally motivated phase classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
